notes.title: Aeneas Middleton Becomes Official Playstation Partner
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38331620/7c38ab0c0a8cc42bca65e3219b9a84a8c1e2b71c.jpg[/img]
Multi-Platinum Producer/Director/Game Developer Aeneas Stephanos Middleton has become an official Playstation Partner. It's official. "I am a PlayStation Partner. Stay Tuned for the next chapter! I look forward to bringing Network E.L.E., and other titles to Playstation in the future" Middleton states. Aeneas Stephanos Middleton #PSVR #VR #VirtualReality #Gaming #RoyalMiddletonEntertainment
